title: Correct Choices, Failed Sequences: Choice2Seq Benchmarks Correctness Retention Across Output Interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.16191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A model may select the correct answer yet fail to construct it through a sequence of local decisions. We introduce Choice2Seq, a diagnostic benchmark that measures correctness retention across complete-answer selection and sequential construction in independent runs on the same problems and candidate sets. Sequence Composition Rate (SCR) measures the fraction of correctly selected items that are also answered correctly through local construction. Jev achieves 97.1% and 99.5% selection accuracy on arithmetic and lexical retrieval, yet retains only 33.0% and 2.1% of those correct choices under serial construction, respectively. Substantial gaps also emerge for StartLux and Qwen, including when Qwen emits characters directly. Restricting local options to candidate-supported characters improves construction, while explicit position indexing improves copying fidelity, even for incorrect selections. These interventions distinguish task correct

translated_title: 正确的选择，失败的序列：Choice2Seq 在不同输出接口间对正确性保持进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 一个模型可能选出正确答案，却无法通过一系列局部决策将其逐步构建出来。我们提出 Choice2Seq，这是一个诊断性基准，用于在相同问题和候选集上的独立运行中，测量模型在完整答案选择与顺序构建之间的正确性保持程度。序列组合率衡量被正确选中的条目中，通过局部构建方式同样答对的比例。Jev 在算术和词汇检索任务上分别达到 97.1% 和 99.5% 的选择准确率，但在串行构建下仅分别保留了这些正确选择中的 33.0% 和 2.1%。StartLux 和 Qwen 也表现出显著差距，即使 Qwen 直接输出字符时也是如此。将局部选项限制为候选集支持的字符可以改善构建效果，而显式的位置索引可以提高复制保真度，即使对于错误的选择同样有效。这些干预措施能够区分任务正确……
tldr: 提出 Choice2Seq 诊断基准，揭示模型虽能高准确率地选出正确答案（如 Jev 达 97-99%），但在逐步构建答案时仅保留 2-33% 的正确性，并证明限制局部选项与显式位置索引可显著改善构建效果。
en_tdlr: Choice2Seq is a diagnostic benchmark revealing that models with near-perfect answer selection accuracy (up to 99.5%) retain as little as 2.1% of correctness under sequential construction, while restricting local options to candidate-supported characters and explicit position indexing significantly improve construction fidelity.
